scripts.cap:build: pnpm build && pnpm exec cap sync
scripts.cap:android: pnpm run cap:build && pnpm exec cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: pnpm run cap:build && pnpm exec cap open ios
scripts.cap:test:android: pnpm run cap:build && pnpm exec cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew connectedAndroidTest
scripts.cap:test:ios: pnpm run cap:build && pnpm exec cap sync ios && xcodebuild test -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15'
scripts.android:build:debug: pnpm run cap:build && pnpm exec cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: pnpm run cap:build && pnpm exec cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:build:bundle: pnpm run cap:build && pnpm exec cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:install:debug: pnpm run android:build:debug && cd android && adb install app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
